_about: Hidden-set scores of internal reference solutions, computed with llm_agents/evaluate_template_bank.py on elara (lalsuite 7.7.1 / lalsimulation 6.2.1). volume_loss_vs_oracle = 1 - relative_to_oracle (lower is better). Scores reproduce exactly only on the same host and software stack; expect ~0.002 scatter otherwise.

starter_ff16_max.description: Starter submission: 16 farthest-first physical templates, statistic max_i |z_i|^2.

pod4_projection.description: 4 weighted-POD (SVD) basis rows, statistic ||C^{-1/2} z||^2 (projection onto the span).

pod8_projection.description: 8 POD rows, projection statistic. Worse than 4 rows: more noise dimensions.

pod8_library_max.description: 8 POD rows, max over a prior-sampled signal library of the whitened per-sample statistic.

pod8_library_lr.description: 8 POD rows, likelihood ratio marginalized (logsumexp) over the same signal library.

pod16_library_lr.description: 16 POD rows, library-marginalized likelihood ratio. Best internal reference.

literature27_marg_lr_w270_phi32.description: Literature mode-filter bank (9 points x 3 orthogonal mode filters, Wadekar et al. 2024, arXiv:2405.17400) with a likelihood ratio marginalized over 270 population-weighted mode-ratio samples and 32 reference phases.
